source_title: 2 PCS Recessed Ceiling Spotlights Modern Waterproof Light
description: A formal living room photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens in a three-quarter corner composition showing both the window wall and the fireplace wall simultaneously. The camera is positioned at the near left corner of the room and looks diagonally toward the far right corner, revealing the full spatial depth of the room. The ceiling is a simple white-painted coffered tray ceiling — a shallow step-down tray inset with crisp crown moulding profiles at the perimeter and along the tray edge, creating architectural depth and the impression of a centered ceiling feature. Recessed can sources are placed within the tray, casting soft wide beams of warm light down onto the seating zone below. The walls are smooth plaster white, pristine and clean. On the right side, a white-painted classical wood fireplace mantel with a flat frieze and simple pilaster columns frames a black firebox with a white marble or stone surround and hearth. Above the mantel hangs a large square abstract oil painting in tones of warm sand, grey, warm brown, and ochre — the dominant artwork in the room. On the left, a tall matte black steel-framed multi-pane window set runs nearly floor to ceiling, dressed with floor-length natural linen drapery panels in a soft greige tone on simple rings, hanging outside the frame. Lush green trees are visible through the glass, flooding the room with soft white daylight. The main seating piece is a large off-white or warm ivory performance fabric deep sectional sofa with a chaise section on the left, dressed with monochromatic ivory and light taupe throw pillows. The coffee table is a low square dark walnut solid wood piece with a distinctive double-pedestal or stacked-slab base, styled with a small potted green plant, a few books, and a pair of small bronze or dark ceramic decorative objects. A classic barrel-back armchair in warm taupe linen sits beside the fireplace. A medium-toned grey woven area rug grounds the seating zone on wide-plank warm honey oak flooring. The mood is serene, clean, and quietly refined. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
